# Pipo Interfaces
> Wireless MIDI and OSC controller modules for creative real-time interactions

## Products
- [Pipo Motion](https://pipointerfaces.com/modules/pipomotion.html): 9-axis wireless motion controller with gyroscope, accelerometer, and magnetometer for gesture control and orientation sensing. Uses ICM-20948 IMU. Price: $159 USD / €147 EUR.
- [Pipo Analog](https://pipointerfaces.com/modules/pipoanalog.html): Versatile I/O board with 8 capacitive touch inputs and 8 voltage inputs (Grove compatible) for building custom MIDI/OSC interfaces. Price: $142 USD / €138 EUR.
- [Pipo Range](https://pipointerfaces.com/modules/piporange.html): Distance sensing controller using Time-of-Flight sensor for Theremin-style control (0.75m close range) or proximity detection (up to 3m). Uses VL53L1CB sensor. Price: $148 USD / €132 EUR.

## Key Features
- Wireless connectivity: Wi-Fi (OSC), Bluetooth LE (MIDI), and USB (MIDI)
- Web-based configuration interface (no app required)
- Low latency: 5-20ms depending on sensor and protocol
- Battery powered with 2.5+ hour runtime
- Dual Wi-Fi mode: access point and station mode simultaneously
- ESP32-S3-Mini based with dual-core 240MHz processor
- Compatible with Ableton Live, TouchDesigner, Max, MadMapper, Bespoke, Pure Data, Isadora, VCV Rack

## Documentation
- [Getting Started Manual](https://pipointerfaces.com/manual/): Complete user guide and tutorials
- [Quick Start Guides](https://pipointerfaces.com/manual/quick-start-guides/common_intro.html): Module-specific setup instructions
- [MIDI Configuration](https://pipointerfaces.com/manual/connectivity/MIDI.html): USB MIDI setup and controls
- [OSC Protocol](https://pipointerfaces.com/manual/connectivity/OSC.html): Wireless OSC configuration
- [Bluetooth Setup](https://pipointerfaces.com/manual/connectivity/BLE.html): BLE MIDI pairing instructions
- [Firmware Updates](https://pipointerfaces.com/update/): Browser-based update page

## Technical Specifications
- Processor: Espressif ESP32-S3-Mini (dual-core 240MHz)
- Connectivity: Wi-Fi 2.4GHz + Bluetooth 5.0 Low Energy
- Power: USB-C charging, onboard lithium battery charger
- Dimensions: Motion/Range 50×38mm, Analog 52×52mm
- Mounting: M3 mounting holes
- Sensors: ICM-20948 (Motion), VL53L1CB (Range), capacitive touch + analog inputs (Analog)

## Use Cases
- Interactive art installations
- Live music performance and MIDI controllers
- Motion-controlled lighting systems
- Educational electronics projects
- Audiovisual performances
- Experimental musical instruments
- Creative coding and physical computing
- Multimedia and performance art
